items.title: Hedge funds on track for another stellar year on AI boom
items.summary: Global hedge funds are on track for another blockbuster year, as they look to surpass their returns from 2025 after an artificial intelligence boom buoyed first-half performance for money managers across most investment strategies, according to a Goldman Sachs note sent to clients that ‌was seen by Reuters.  During the first six months of this year, hedge funds returned an average of 7%, well above the 10-year average of 4.1%, according ‌to the Goldman report.  It marks the sixth consecutive half-year period in which hedge ​fund returns exceeded their long-term average.
